name: room-reorder-drag
description: Bug #10: the Reorder-rooms modal uses a hamburger drag handle per row instead of up/down buttons.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13)

steps.name: assert-handles-present
steps.eval: (()=>{const h=document.querySelectorAll('.room-reorder-handle');if(h.length===0)throw new Error('no drag handles rendered');const up=[...document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label^="Move "]')];if(up.length>0)throw new Error('old up/down move buttons still present: '+up.length)})()
